title: Private-data error lab

fixture_files.issue: sample S-004 appears twice and one value is negative
fixture_files.repair: resolve the duplicate against the source and correct or redeclare the expression scale before import

fixture_files.issue: the time column is labeled months while the data dictionary declares days
fixture_files.repair: resolve the unit from the source documentation; never infer it from the numeric range

fixture_files.issue: sample S-009 has no outcome match
fixture_files.repair: retain the original row, report the unmatched ID and exclude it only from linked analyses

fixture_files.issue: rare_subtype has only 3 usable patients in one level
fixture_files.repair: do not use the sparse level for a two-group analysis unless a scientifically justified rule was declared independently

fixture_files.issue: therapy_response is measured after baseline treatment
fixture_files.repair: do not add it automatically to a baseline Cox model or use it as independent baseline evidence

repairable_notices: unmatched identifiers retained in only one table
scenario.privacy_boundary: The fixture contains synthetic identifiers only; a reusable checklist must preserve source files and exclude direct identifiers from uploads and exports.

answer_key: Duplicate identifiers and invalid scale values block import; unmatched identifiers may be repairable notices; time units and measurement timing always require semantic review.
interpretation_boundary: Uploaded metadata remain descriptive or filtering variables and are never added automatically to a Cox model.
completion_rule: Completion depends on correctly classifying the issue, not on forcing every fixture to import.
